rationale: C10 is an exceptionally close and recent drafting template. It uses the same tax-return list and punctuation, the same temporal and congressional authorization structure, the same committee/subcommittee formulation, the same purpose clause tied to a congressional authorization, the identical compliance machinery citing Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 approved May 3, 1955, and the same effectiveness sentence. The child primarily substitutes the investigating House committee, its authorizing rule, its purpose, and extends the covered period through 1955. C08 and C13 are also strong templates for the same machinery, but C10 more exactly matches the child's numbered Treasury-decision citation and purpose-clause construction.
